findings.statement: The 2012 original-author JMSS paper supplies named Yes/No or numeric tables for the clinical/ECG core, history definitions for DM/HTN/smoking/FH, BP as Blood Pressure 90-190, PR as Pulse Rate 50-110, four parallel chest-pain flags, Cath >=50, 37 features, and a chest-pain angiography-referred cohort. EJSR derived BP2/PR2 cut-offs are compatible with systolic BP and bpm pulse-rate interpretation of the derived features. This is not the only accessible original-author full text.

The 2013 RCM original-author open full text (DOI 10.5812/cardiovascmed.10888, PMC4253773), a different paper from paywalled 2013 CMPB, supplies Table 1 16 named demographics with Yes/No counts (Length omitted) and Table 2 17 named laboratory/echo fields with numeric ranges. Name correspondence with the frozen 17 laboratory-and-echo group is 17/17 at token level. The paper never states 54 features, does not restate a 50% cut-off, does not document BP/PR/chest pain, does not print lab units except EF(%), does not supply per-feature pre-angiography timestamps, and does not prove that its 303 rows are the UCI workbook or the 2012 cohort.

Abandoned US20150370996A1 Table 1 prints inventor tokens BP (Blood Pressure: mmHg) 90-190 and PR (Pulse Rate) (ppm) 50-110. That is inventor-printed provenance, not verified UCI-412 xlsx semantics, not systolic versus diastolic, and not a clinical definition of ppm. The patent embodiment is 335 patients and 50 features, which must not be conflated with UCI-412 303/54. CAD >=50% wording corroborates the UCI landing page but does not resolve the exact-50% conflict. Patent 100% sensitivity is not a CardioAssist result. 0/16 pre-angiography times unchanged.

UCI-412 and 2012 JMSS state >=50%. 2016 KBS and 2017 Arabasadi/Alizadehsani state more/higher than 50%. Exact-50% handling is unresolved. UCI landing-page >=50% remains the source-defined rule for this project.

Original 2012: 37 features. Original 2013 RCM: 16 named demographics plus 17 named lab/echo (paper does not state 54); Length used in Gini only. Author 2013 CMPB/2016/2017/UCI/Mendeley: 54. Inventor patent embodiment: 50 features / 335 patients, unreconciled with UCI-412 303/54. Secondary tables: 55. UCI UI/API: 56 blank variable rows. Local audit: 55 predictors + Cath. UCI-411: 59. Arithmetic 37+17=54 is an original-author-table hypothesis, not adopted. 54+3!=59 but 56+3=59. Rhythm vs BBB, Function Class 1-4 vs 0-3, Length omitted/included, and several lab ranges vs frozen secondary ranges remain unresolved. No count adopted. n=303 is not a verified row join. Do not set n=335.

0/16 owner-verified pre-angiography timestamps. 2012 describes volunteers for angiography; 2013 RCM describes chest-pain referrals and modelling to obviate angiography using lab/echo features; 2015 patent proposes an algorithm for determining the need for angiography. All are design intent, not a field-level clock. Patent 335 is not a join to UCI-412 303.

No original case-record form, supplementary codebook or owner-signed acquisition protocol was found. 2013 RCM Tables 1-2 are published original-author tables, not a CRF. UCI API field metadata is structurally present and empty.

Owner publishes 413 patients, 413 videos as a separate Highlights count, two XLSX files plus RAR video archive, cc-by-4.0, and retrospective angiographic collection. Schema, pretest timing and owner binary CAD rule are NOT VERIFIED IN ACCESSIBLE MATERIALS. CC BY 4.0 deed has no NC clause; article says non-commercial.

Secondary code describes 377 clinical rows, 15 segment columns, constructed >50% patient label, STEMI 49.3%, 39 clinical inputs including LVEF, Gensini leaky. Not an owner codebook and not Track A eligibility.
AngioCAD remains SCIENTIFIC_HOLD_NOT_ADMITTED. Supervisor colour P25 REJECTED_RED unchanged. Not written into questions[].status.
2012 lists Exertional CP as a Yes/No column. Zhang 2022 reports constancy on that paper's copy and drops External CP. Hypothesis only; no panel change.
